dict.string: Show upcoming events on this shared iPad screen only after you opt in.
After a sound in standby, briefly check for a nearby face using the front TrueDepth camera. No images or depth data are saved or uploaded.
HomeViewPad shows your home accessories, runs scenes you select, and displays cameras only when you open them.
Show weather for your current city. If location is unavailable, HomeViewPad uses Philadelphia. Approximate coordinates are sent to Apple Weather for weather.
While foreground standby is dimmed, detect sound levels to wake the display or start a short TrueDepth check. No audio is recorded or uploaded.
Display photos from the iPad albums you choose in the HomeViewPad photo widget. HomeViewPad never changes your photo library.
Show open reminders on this shared iPad screen only after you opt in.
